line_label: Namenda (printed 'Namenda®'; footnote: 'Includes Namenda XR and Namenda IR')
revenue_scope: Combined Namenda line: Namenda XR plus Namenda IR net revenues, Total column of Allergan plc's product revenue tables
geography: U.S. (the International column prints '-' on every row)
why_separate: From 2018Q4 Allergan plc stopped printing a Namenda XR row and prints one 'Namenda' row that its footnote defines as including both Namenda XR and Namenda IR, so the figure is a broader line and not Namenda XR alone.
notes: Continuation runs 2018Q4-2020Q1, the last quarter Allergan plc reported (Form 10-Q filed 2020-05-07; AbbVie closed the acquisition on 2020-05-08). The 2018Q4 release prints the row without a footnote and prior-year column 97.8, equal to the 2017Q4 value (97.8) of the Namenda XR gold series; the footnote 'Includes Namenda XR and Namenda IR' is first printed in the 2019Q1 release. Full-year 2019 check: 9.5+6.1+4.0+3.2 = 22.8, as printed in the 2019Q4 release. AbbVie (CIK 1551152) prints no Namenda row after the acquisition: no earnings exhibit and no Form 10-Q/10-K from 2020-05-01 to 2026-10-05 carries a revenue row for Namenda; the main documents mention Namenda only in the antitrust and False Claims Act litigation notes. No continuation after 2020Q1.
search_log: Allergan plc (CIK 0001578845) earnings 8-Ks and 10-Qs listed via data.sec.gov/submissions from 2018-10 to 2020-05; Exhibit 99.1 of the 2019-01-29, 2019-05-07, 2019-08-06, 2019-11-05 and 2020-02-10 releases and the 2020-05-07 Form 10-Q parsed for rows containing 'Namenda'; each prints a single 'Namenda' row and no Namenda XR row.

Footnote text 'Includes Namenda XR and Namenda IR' found on the Namenda row of the 2019-05-07, 2019-08-06, 2019-11-05 and 2020-02-10 releases and the 2020-05-07 Form 10-Q; the 2019-01-29 release prints the row without a footnote.

AbbVie (CIK 0001551152): all Item 2.02 8-K exhibits and Forms 10-Q/10-K from 2020-05-01 to 2026-10-05 (75 filings, every main document and Exhibit 99 downloaded and searched case-insensitively for Namenda, Aczone, Avycaz, Viberzi, eluxadoline, dapsone): Namenda appears only in the litigation notes of the 10-Q/10-K main documents, never in a revenue table; AbbVie's product tables carry no Namenda line.

continuation.evidence: Allergan plc Q1 2019 earnings release, table row 'Namenda ® (3)' with footnote '(3) Includes Namenda XR ® and Namenda ® IR.' (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1578845/000114420419024034/tv520757_ex99-1.htm). The line first appears, without the footnote, in the Q4 2018 release: 'NAMENDA ® net revenues in the fourth quarter of 2018 were $10.7 million compared to $97.8 million in the prior year quarter, impacted by loss of patent exclusivity for NAMENDA XR ® in February 2018' (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1578845/000114420419003275/tv511761_ex99-1.htm).
